$comment: GitHub Copilot model retirements (#303). Plan Forge must not default to a model listed here.
Value: the retirement date. Where GitHub announced one window for several models, the date is the window's end.
Add a model when GitHub announces its retirement. The weekly Model Drift workflow (scripts/check-model-drift.mjs)
fails when a default retires within 30 days, and model-defaults-contract.test.mjs fails once it has.
Only a passed retirement date drops a model from pforge-mcp/copilot-pricing.json: the live model list is one account's view (#393).
claude-opus-4.8 stays available to individual Copilot subscribers on annual plans; the deprecation applies to everyone else.
source: GitHub Copilot supported-models page and changelog: the 2026-09-30 model refresh and the 2026-10-15 deprecation notice
